profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle | Applied AI | Ex-Siemens
profile.summary:
Master’s-educated Senior Software Engineer with over 20 years of foundational expertise architecting, deploying, and optimizing enterprise-grade solutions.

My career is defined by a proven track record of driving full-cycle product development across high-impact domains—including complex ERP integrations, cloud infrastructures, and digital commerce—with notable engineering contributions at industry leaders like Oracle and Siemens.

Today, I blend decades of deep backend system design experience with cutting-edge AI-driven engineering. Leveraging Python, Java, and advanced AI capabilities, I focus on accelerating development lifecycles, automating sophisticated technical investigations, and translating intricate client needs into scalable production realities. 

Core Capabilities:

• AI-Driven Design & Engineering: Implementing modern AI workflows alongside robust Python and Java architectures to build highly efficient, intelligent software systems.

• Comprehensive System Investigation: Diagnosing and resolving complex backend challenges across cloud-based and on-premises environments.

• Full-Cycle Execution & Delivery: Bridging deep technical implementation with executive-level customer interaction, cross-functional communication, and strategic project planning.
